basic_info.description: Open House 2/8 & 2/9 2-4pm!| This bright and spacious 1BR/1BA condo, offering 962 SF of living space, is located at The Beacon in the vibrant heart of Mission Bay/South Beach. Oversized windows bathe the home in natural light and provide breathtaking views of Bay, Mission Bay and Oracle Park. The open-concept floor plan seamlessly connects a gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and wooden cabinets to expansive living and dining areas, ideal for both entertaining and relaxing. The generous master suite boasts a walk-in closet, while the luxurious bath features a glass-enclosed shower. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, an assigned parking space, and access to top-tier amenities such as 24/7 doorman/security, a heated outdoor pool, fitness center, sauna, newly redesigned clubhouse with kitchen, business center/conference room, beautifully landscaped grounds, and a dog park. With parking included and located in the coveted Mission Bay neighborhood, this home offers direct access to Safeway and is just steps from the Embarcadero Waterfront, Ferry Building, Oracle Park, Chase Center, Michelin-starred dining, fitness studios, and excellent public transportation options, including Caltrain, Muni, subway, T-Line
